status: NEW 2026-10-06 (refill cycle, zero GPU spend). First-ever single-session composition of all FOUR rl_only roles (rise+hold -> walk -> turn-and-hold -> controlled lower) -- closes the gap both STATUS.md and walkcurr/STATUS.md named ('bundle_rlonly_lifecycle_v2 has rise+walk+lower but no turn; bundle_rlonly_curvewalk_v1 has walk+turn but no rise/lower; nobody has stitched all four'). Built by generalizing the two existing pairwise composition tools' own cross-env-reanchor precedent (eval_lifecycle_handoff_rlonly.py's rise->walk->lower chain, eval_walk_turn_compose.py's walk<->turn chain) into one new tool, not a new mechanism. SIM-ONLY, forward-heading (0deg) read so far; 8-heading off-axis confirmation sweep launched same cycle (see transfer_blockers_or_work) before this is cited as full-direction evidence.
training_lineage_contract: walkcurr rl_only (tracks.json): all FOUR composed roles are independently-trained clean-RL checkpoints, no BC/AMP/demo/gait-clock anywhere in any role's own lineage -- this manifest adds no new training/weights, only a 3rd cross-env reanchor handoff (walk->turn) alongside the two bundle_rlonly_lifecycle_v2 already established (rise->walk, walk->lower). stance = bundle_rlonly_stance_v1's currentcap29-s5-klrollback05-acq15m. walk = bundle_rlonly_v2/slew_smooth_s0 (wrapped in rot60.Rot60Policy, the already-validated full-direction fix). turn = walkcurr's acq5-seedsweep-s5 recipe champion's hippitchfix-ft1 continuation (cw-walkyaw50hz-rlonly-scratch-sac-s5-acq5-seedsweep-hippitchfix-ft1, PASS 2026-10-06 -- the post-regression-fix checkpoint that recovers bundle_rlonly_curvewalk_v1's composed gate under the current safety.hip_pitch_max_deg=29.8 default). lower = thermalderate50-s2 (bundle_rlonly_lifecycle_v2's current adopted champion).

components.role: walk (forward joystick walk, 50Hz hardware-transfer reference, rot60-wrapped)
lower (controlled descent from turn-exit state back to sit)
components.note: Trained with motor.thermal_derate_enable=1/thermal_derate_max_frac=0.5 -- a physics key that MUST be replayed at eval (this bundle's own harness auto-applies it as a default, see eval_lifecycle_full_rlonly.py's --lower-cfg help) or the champion runs under the wrong actuator model and over_current-fails (confirmed the hard way smoke-testing this tool before trusting its first number: 5/36 without the replay -> 33/36 with it, same checkpoint).

composition_mechanism.type: direct handoff x3 (stance->walk, walk->turn, turn->lower), no scripted blend
composition_mechanism.description: Four SimHexapodJointWalkEnv instances, one per role's own exact recorded cfg-set recipe (each differs in actuator/safety/task cfg cached at env __init__ -- bus profile, safety.max_delta_q_deg, box_yaw, motor.thermal_derate_*). At each of the three handoff ticks the raw physical state (qpos/qvel/ctrl/act + SafetyLayer._last_safe slew memory) is copied from the outgoing env into a freshly-reset incoming env (the established cross-env reanchor trick, imported from eval_lifecycle_handoff_rlonly.py, not re-derived), then mj_forward + a rebuilt observation. No joint trajectory is scripted at any handoff. The walk segment optionally extends its stop phase up to --settle-grounded-s until all six feet contact simultaneously before handing to turn (eval_walk_turn_compose.py's own leg-3-unload-during-hold fix, reused).

gate_summary.harness: rl_move/sim/eval_lifecycle_full_rlonly.py, single 'direct' arm (full rise->walk->turn->lower chain; the two already-established pairwise plant controls -- walk's own clean reset in eval_lifecycle_handoff_rlonly.py, turn's own clean reset in eval_walk_turn_compose.py -- already exist on those tools and are not re-run here).

forward_heading_det_n36_seed0.result: rise 36/36, walk 36/36 (gait_valid), turn 36/36 (gait_valid + converged, Q4 mean yaw-offset err well under the 0.05rad bar), lower 33/36 (91.7%). zero_fall_episodes 33/36.
forward_heading_det_n36_seed0.failure_detail: 3 residual failures: 1 height-miss-without-fall (-15.8mm, just past the 15mm bar) + 2 tilt_roll falls. ZERO over_current -- matches the thermalderate50-s2 champion's own established failure-mode signature exactly (walkcurr/STATUS.md: 'Residual 12/108 failures are mostly pre-existing height-miss-without-fall (9) plus rare tilt_roll falls (3, 2.8%)'). The turn segment insertion costs NOTHING vs that role's own standalone rise->walk->lower number (33/36 was literally this seed's own official forward-only gate score) -- no new turn-interaction pathology detected at this n.

gate_summary.verdict: First full 4-role rl_only lifecycle composition: 91.7% zero-fall end-to-end (forward heading), matching the lower role's own already-accepted standalone composed rate bit-for-bit, with the same already-characterized residual failure signature. Evidence FOR the full lifecycle being compositionally free (no new interaction cost from adding the turn segment), NOT yet full-direction evidence (see blockers).

transfer_blockers_or_work: FORWARD-HEADING ONLY so far (heading_deg=0.0) -- the 8-heading off-axis confirmation sweep every other champion on this track needed before being trusted/promoted (lowerrole_truechamp_fulldir_n20_2026-10-03, lowerrole_thermalderate50_fulldir_n20_2026-10-06) was launched the same cycle this manifest was created; see STATUS docs for its result before citing this as full-direction evidence.

Each role's own motor/safety contract differs (stance/lower bus 400/20, walk bus 4096/1000, turn its own acq5-seedsweep contract; safety.max_delta_q_deg/hip_pitch_max_deg vary) -- any physical composed runtime must switch the active contract at each of the three handoffs, not run one contract throughout (the same caveat bundle_rlonly_lifecycle_v2/curvewalk_v1 already name, now x3 handoffs instead of x1/x2). No such runtime is built -- Robot-Lab-owned per walkcurr/STATUS.md Next item 1.
This is a SIM-ONLY composition result (CPU MuJoCo, mesh_mjx model, no GPU spend, no physical robot motion). No physical acceptance is claimed.

No video/strip evidence generated yet for this specific 4-role chain (the tool supports --strips; not run this cycle to keep the first read fast) -- a demo video is a cheap follow-up once the off-axis read lands, same convention bundle_rlonly_curvewalk_v1's joystick_demo1.mp4 set.

Turn-offset cycles through the acq5-seedsweep recipe's own OFFSET_SET_DEG (15/30/45/90 deg family) one per episode, not a fixed single offset -- this is the SAME convention eval_walk_turn_compose.py's own registered gate already uses, not a new easier test.
